commit.message:
Update contributors and enhance debug control documentation

- Added Erik Kraft and Thomas Roecker to the contributors list.
- Expanded the documentation on S-mode, VS-mode, and U-mode debug control, detailing the new fields introduced by the Smsdedbg and Smvsdedbg extensions.
- Clarified the maximum allowed privilege mode and debug access privilege configurations in the sdsec.adoc file.
- Updated the external-debug-security.pdf to reflect changes in the documentation.
- Add the overview description of sdsec and its optional extensions
- reorg the overview for sdsec
- Re-org M-mode control subsection
- Update the M-mode control

- Add extension name for M-mode debug control though still leave sdsec as it is
- Complete the S/HS-mode debug control
- Add corresponding CSR part for S/HS-mode debug control
- Draft the vs-mode debug control (WIP)
- add U-mode optional extension
- fix several inaccurate description in external debug security extension
- update the description for trace with new extension organization.
Merge branch 'main' into 0.7.3_msu
- replace shall in non-normative text and add notes for corresponding sub-extensions
- Re-organize the trace control into each sub-extensions
- Generalize the text in intro and dmextsec by removing "supervisor domain"
Merge branch '0.7.3_msu' of https://github.com/riscv-non-isa/riscv-external-debug-security into 0.7.3_msu
- update the threat model and add pelp
Fix wording
Re-org the text to put normative description into sub extensions
Add the default control status if the optional extension is not implemented
Split Sdsec into separate debug and trace extension hierarchies
- furthur split the trace and external debug extensions
- Improve the organization and move some table to appendix
- remove 'v' in udcsr
- add 'ebreaku' in udcsr
- move the descriptive text to bullets
- update the appendix based on per-privilege external debug and trace control
- proofread and fix inaccurate descriptions
- Fix the table format

- Refine language for clarity and consistency in the Debug Module Security Extension documentation.
- Adjust descriptions for debug and trace control fields to enhance readability and precision.
- Ensure proper formatting and grammatical accuracy throughout the document.

- fix the fields honored when DMPRV is 1
- fix typo

Clarify conditions for debug and trace control fields in the Sdsec documentation. Update descriptions for `SDEDBGALW`, `VSEDBGALW`, `USEDBGALW`, `SDETRCALW`, `VSETRCALW`, and `USETRCALW` to specify that they only take effect when certain conditions are met, enhancing accuracy and readability.

Update version to v0.7.3 and change revision mark to "Release Candidate for Internal Review". Remove outdated section on trigger delegation from Sdsec documentation. Update external-debug-security.pdf to reflect recent changes.
